title: The Second Piggyback Ride
text: “It’s fine that we’re learning magic, but what about Wolf, the Claw Hero?”
“Pen?”
“Ah, apparently this one’s exclusive to holders of Legendary Weapons, nano.”
“Really? So Seven Star Weapon heroes can’t learn it?”
“As long as you know the magic script, the Staff Hero can chant it, nano~”
Trash had been able to use it too, come to think of it. In that sense, there was no doubt that Trash was a hero the Crimson Swine’s true body had wanted sealed away by any means necessary.
“I think we’ve got the stone tablet handled well enough. So, next is figuring out how to bring up the hidden island.”
“Naofumi, don’t you need to be a peckul for this?”
“I’m experimenting to see if Wolf can substitute for one. If it turns out to be difficult, I’ll have Shion, Theo, Wolf, and the other Demi-Humans and Beastmen step back, and I’ll transform too.”
And so, we each got ourselves ready for a piggyback ride, I say. We stamped our feet against the ground over and over as we waited, indeed.
“Ah… Yuki, you need to hold onto Spear Hero properly to get him up to the third tier, nano. Otherwise he’ll come stomping up triumphantly and just plant himself on top, nano.”
“Are you planning to stomp on us!?”
“Not happening!”
Itsuki and Ren both braced themselves, indeed.
“There is no other way to build a proper piggyback formation, I say!”
“You just get sealed off first because you always try some extra way of climbing on, nano!”
“Sounds like Rafumi-chan’s having a grand old time over there…”
I swear I could hear Rafumi’s laughter somewhere. She had to be nearby—no doubt about it, indeed. That one’s a nightmare since she can split into pieces, I say.
“Grr! Then—Keel!”
“Eh? Why am I getting dragged into this now? Shouldn’t it be Big Brother Kelsus!?”
Was this some kind of test to see if Keel could function in the inult slot?
“Might as well try it, nano.”
Since it was an experiment, Rival didn’t seem to object.
“That’s harsh, Gaelion-chan! Fine, I’ve got a trick up my sleeve too! Luna-chan! Grab hold of Big Brother Kelsus and get ready!”
“Ohh~”
“Hey, stop it, Luna! Not me! You’re turning Keel into the totem, dammit!!”
And so Ren thrashed about as Luna-chan held him tight, indeed.
“What are you even doing… let’s just hurry this along.”
“Yuki-chan! Itsuki’s cheeks puff up whenever he goes underwater, I say!”
“Why are you brining that up right now? …It’s true, though. Swimming’s kind of a hassle for me.”
“Spear Hero… are you trying to make that your running gag? You’ve mentioned it before too, nano.”
Itsuki’s response was sour, indeed.
“I’d love to see that!”
“Yuki-chan, think before you speak, please. I don’t think Itsuki’s cheek pouches puffing up is exactly a fun spectacle, is it?”
“Well… it does come up as a gimmick in the next dungeon, nano.”
“…I see. Was that a courtesy, letting me know ahead of time?”
Rival gave a quiet nod at Itsuki’s words.
“Getting held a grudge against and thrashed about would be a pain, nano.”
“If it’s out of consideration, I suppose there’s nothing to be done… I’ll accept that scene with grace.”
Itsuki’s reaction was so flat it looked devoid of any feeling at all, I say.
“I absolutely want to see it!”
Ren protested, indeed.
“Sword Hero…”
“It’s Kelsus, arf!”
“I get that you want more gag-buddies, but making it the current Bow Hero would be a hassle, so please just bear with it, nano.”
“What about me!?”
“You’re not quite pitiful enough for that, so it’s fine, nano.”
“Don’t mess with me!”
While Ren kept protesting, Father approached Wolf, who was in peckul form, indeed.
“I’ll carry Wolf.”
“Wolf-peeen.”

Wolf didn’t put up any fuss and let Father scoop him up. Rival’s prepared tools were slotted into the weapons, and Ren, Itsuki, and Wolf transformed accordingly. I switched my own equipment to match, as well.
“Allow me to carry you.”
Yuki-chan was the one carrying me, apparently.
“Ehehe~ so cute~”
Luna-chan watched the whole scene with a beaming smile plastered across her face.
“Luna-chan. What a great smile.”
“Well, I suppose this place is basically heaven for Luna-chan.”

The last time we came adventuring to Cal Mira Island in fairy form… gah, Luna-chan had been radiating a downright terrifying presence back then, all because Keel wasn’t around. But in this loop, she was playing with Keel and Ren, so she was smiling serenely instead—no cause for concern, indeed.
“Who’s carrying me… ah, the rabbit fellow, if you would.”
“I’d have thought Rishia-san or someone, but… well, fine, I understand.”
Rabbit Guy hoisted Itsuki up, indeed. And with that, Ren, Itsuki, me, and Wolf formed a piggyback tower—totem complete, I say.
“All right… everyone, let go of your hold now—”
“It’s a shame Father isn’t on top of me, peeeyon.”
Out of spite, I tried pinching Itsuki’s face between my feet. But—that bastard Itsuki grabbed my leg firmly, so I couldn’t pinch him at all, I say!
“I already anticipated the kind of trick you’d try to pull.”
Grr… how impudent, indeed!
“Spear Hero, behave yourself, nano. Naofumi, you scold him too, nano.”
“Yeah. Motoyasu-kun, stay still, please.”
“Since Father isn’t climbing up here, I won’t do anything, peeyon.”
That sight of Father climbing up before had honestly been rather charming, indeed.
“Well, it’s just that… in peckul form, my legs are pretty short, so… climbing up this totem is quite a chore.”
Father’s enchanting belly, peeyon. Nice and fluffy, delightful to the touch, indeed. Wolf’s belly? No, that’s not it, peeyon. That’s not it, peeyon! It’s warm, but that’s not it, peeyon!
“I feel like Motoyasu-kun isn’t moving, yet somehow it’s still noisy.”
“Even standing still he’s a noisy one, nano.”
“How cruel, peeyon!”

And then—right in front of the totem, mid-piggyback, a crackle of electricity surged through the air, indeed. I’d experienced this before. The area around the totem and the ground beneath us began to glow. A red bolt like lightning shot across the earth with a flash, and a rumbling sound began, indeed. At the same time, the eyes of the totem’s carved pioneer animals lit up, indeed.
“The gimmick’s activated, nano. You can let go now, nano.”
“Hup!”
“Whoa! Peeyon!?”
“Pen!?”
Seizing the moment, Itsuki flung me off! I was about to plummet straight down, but I gracefully executed a double jump and landed with poise, indeed.
“What are you doing, peeyon!”
“Stop climbing on top of me all the time. It’s unpleasant. I’m the one who rides, not the one ridden.”
“Then why do you climb onto Father so often, indeed!?”
“You two really don’t get along…”
Wolf botched the landing and went rolling, indeed. Itsuki dismounted from Ren as if nothing at all had happened.
“Ow, ow…”
“Wolf, are you okay?”
“Peeen! I’m fine.”
With Father worrying over him, Wolf picked himself back up.
“Itsuki was awful, peeyon!”
“Now, now… the real cause here is Motoyasu-kun.”
While Father soothed my protest, over by the shore, an island began rising up out of the sea, indeed.
“What is that!?”
“A new island!?”
“Just now, there was a creature they called a native of Cal Mira Island!”
“Apparently it’s the heroes. Seems like one of them solved the island’s mystery.”
“Amaziiing…”
And so on—more or less the same exchange I’d overheard in other loops, indeed. This would surely bring even more excitement to the island.
“I’d heard about it, but… well, that confirms it.”
“Wasn’t it that the dungeon on that island can only be entered by heroes, or rather, by those in pioneer fairy form?”
“Nano.”
“Gaelion sure knows a lot about this.”
Assistant, watching from a distance, murmured under her breath, indeed.
“Nano!”

I really did wonder how she was covering her tracks. When I’d asked Father about it that night, apparently he’d explained it away as Gaelion gaining memories from another loop through my spear. It was technically true, but was that really enough for Assistant to just accept it, indeed? Incidentally, Jack was already firmly attached to Assistant’s chest. Pitiful, peeyon. And so, we made landfall on the island, indeed.
“Peeen.”
“Wolf, I honestly can’t tell anymore whether you’re supposed to be a wolf or a penguin…”
“Let’s go!”
“Ohh~”
And with that, it seemed Ren was riding Luna-chan together with Keel toward the island, indeed.
“Please wait, Re—”
“Don’t you dare get my name wrong, arf!”

Ren kept yipping warnings at his companion over and over, indeed. They moved forward like waterfowl gliding across the surface. Yuki-chan carried me along as well, advancing right beside them, indeed.
